briefs.prompt: Generate one exceptional photorealistic cinematic landscape background for a refined personal portfolio website hero. Landscape aspect ratio 16:9, high detail, film grain, restrained color, subtle atmosphere, editorial architecture and travel photography aesthetic. Full bleed background ONLY, absolutely no people, no typography, no letters, no UI, no logos, no watermarks. The website will overlay large ivory type in the left 45% and a human portrait at x=72%, so leave the left readable with dark negative space and the upper right fairly calm. Strong three-dimensional depth with near, middle, and far planes, appropriate for a gentle parallax effect. No fantasy video game look, no giant planets, no spaceships, no neon grids, no exaggerated stars. Direction HORIZON / Professional: a silent blue-hour volcanic landscape seen from a low elevated viewpoint, deep midnight indigo sky with just a few distant pinpoint stars. A long slender pale blue atmospheric horizon at 44% height, layers of charcoal blue mineral dunes across the lower half, a thin bank of luminous mist passing between the dunes. Dark smooth foreground slopes across lower left, distant slate mountain ridges right. The subtle feeling of space comes only from the vastness and cold light. Sleek, spacious, tactile, calm. Indigo black, muted silver blue, delicate lavender. No buildings, no arches, no planets.
